note: The import commit holds src/gated_delta.py and LICENSE byte-identical to the installed mlx-lm 0.31.0 wheel (the wheel RECORD hash above equals upstream_sha256 of the Python file). gated_delta_step.metal is derived, not patched: it is the Metal source text of the scalar-gate, unmasked variant, byte for byte.
